title: TapCheck
summary: A browser extension that tells you, on the ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini page itself, when another extension is wiretapping your chat.

generator.cover_prompt: A glowing translucent glass chat bubble floating centered slightly above middle, with a thin copper wire discreetly tapped into its underside, while a large round magnifying lens hovers over the wire and reveals it in sharp bright detail against a softly blurred surface. Modern editorial-tech illustration, clean vector-influenced shapes, soft gradients, subtle depth and gentle shadows. Palette: deep indigo, electric teal, warm amber, off-white. Centered composition with generous margins and negative space, soft rim lighting from the upper left. Mood: quietly vigilant. STRICT: no text, letters, words, numbers, captions, titles, labels, banners, credits, stat blocks, logos, watermarks, signatures, UI chrome, or borders anywhere in the image.
